# Assumption of Moses Chapter 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Return, the Hasmoneans, and Antiochus

---

**1** When they return from among the nations and are restored to the land of their fathers, the two tribes will also be restored to their land.

**2** At that time certain men will arise among them who will hate sinners and love righteousness.

**3** But in those days men will also arise who will call themselves priests of the Most High God, yet they will be deeply deceptive, for great wickedness will be found among them.

**4** They will set up a golden lamp and make a shrine for it in a foreign place, and they will pollute the whole earth with the filth of their practices.

**5** They will not seek the Lord, because their hearts are surrendered to wickedness.

**6** They will be arrogant, they will commit sin, and they will treat holy things with contempt.

**7** They will say: we are guilty of great sin, but we will not be judged for it.

**8** For they will love transient glory and will turn to a foreign god.

**9** Then from one of the tribes a powerful and mighty man will be raised up.

**10** He will come and rule over Israel, and he will reign for thirty-four years.

**11** Then suddenly a powerful enemy will arise on his right hand, come upon him, and overthrow his kingdom.

**12** In those days mighty kings will come and take control of them and will reign over them for thirty-four years.

**13** He will construct a building for them in the holy city in which sacrifices will be offered to him and they will be made to serve him with foreign rites.

**14** He will commit evil deeds among them and will afflict them in many ways.

**15** He will appoint an overseer over them to punish those who refuse to obey his wicked decrees.

**16** He will force the uncircumcised to be circumcised and will compel the circumcised to become uncircumcised.

**17** He will put many to death and will force the survivors to follow the customs of the nations.

**18** In this way he will oppress them for a year and a half.
